summary: OpenAI describes safety training work for the o1 and o1-mini models, including a deliberative alignment technique where the model reasons about safety policies in context, plus associated safety evaluations and red-teaming.

practices.reason: Describes a safety evaluation methodology (deliberative alignment, red teaming, Preparedness Framework evaluations) that changes how one might measure model safety, but the technique is tied to OpenAI's own training pipeline.
practices.quote: This report outlines the safety work carried out for the OpenAI o1 and OpenAI o1-mini models, including safety evaluations, external red teaming, and Preparedness Framework evaluations.
